title: Primer of the Three-Tined Fork
summary: Teaches a first-time student the two-hand grip and plain forward jab of the trident using body strength alone.

title: Handbook of the Spaced Grip
summary: Drills the shoulder-wide grip and straight lunge of the trident for students who have only begun to harden the skin.

title: The Shore-Fisher's Trident Drills
summary: Sets out wet-ground stance and darting stab drills for a muscled body with no qi and a fisher's habits.

title: Workbook of Straight Prong Lines
summary: Practices straight shoulder-to-target thrusts and the first notch catches for students whose tendons are already toughened.

title: Trident Basics for the Heavy Frame
summary: Shows large and bone-hardened students how to use their weight behind the trident without qi.

title: Plain Trident Footwork and Reach
summary: Teaches a student who has just awakened qi how to add reach and footwork to the trident.

title: Canon of the Central Prong
summary: Sets out qi-lightened thrusts of the center prong and the outer-tine rakes for early Senior students.

title: Pinning and Lifting with the Trident
summary: Teaches pinning garments and lifting nets or shield rims with the tines using the first qi pressure.

title: Treatise on Tine-Catching Guards
summary: A treatise on catching and turning an enemy blade in the fork of the trident with qi-steadied guards.

title: The Wader's Trident Handbook
summary: Teaches low crouched thrusts and steady footing on slick banks for students who work in shallow water.
